description: Build an Accept-CH response-header value from a list of client hint names (e.g. Sec-CH-UA-Platform, Sec-CH-DPR) the server wants the browser to send on future requests, attaching a plain-English note on what each hint reveals. Pass a subset of those names as criticalHintNames to also build a Critical-CH header value, for hints the server needs on the very first request of a session.

criticalHintNames.description: Optional subset of hintNames to also mark critical (builds a Critical-CH header value)

hintNames.description: Client hint names to request, e.g. "Sec-CH-UA-Platform"

name: build_client_hints
